welcome-sub: Gateway to Empowering Africa Through the Pi Ecosystem
africa-day: (In celebrating 25th Africa Day, this Pi Pioneers Training Application is launched)
intro-p1: Pi Network is a digital currency and global ecosystem project designed to make cryptocurrency accessible and useful for everyone.
intro-p2: Unlike traditional cryptocurrencies that require expensive mining machines, Pi Network allows ordinary people to participate directly from their phones.
intro-list:
• Build an inclusive digital economy
  • Empower ordinary people worldwide
  • Increase real-life usage
  • Support person-to-person commerce
ch1-p1: Step 1: Download Pi Network - Use invitation link: minepi.com/chigalex1
ch1-p2: Step 2: Register with Facebook or Phone → Enter code: CHIGALEX1 → Get 1 Pi reward
ch1-p3: Daily Mining: Return every 24h and click the lightning button to continue mining. This proves you are human and active.
ch1-list:
• Create Pi wallet securely
  • Complete 2FA
  • Complete KYC
  • Prepare for Mainnet migration
security-msg: ⚠️ Wallet security: Never share your 24 passphrase words! Pi Core Team will NEVER ask for it!
ch2-p1: Your Pi Wallet is your bank in the Pi Ecosystem. It holds your Pi coins securely on the blockchain.
ch2-p2: How to create: Open Pi Browser → Wallet → Generate Wallet → COPY your 24 words → Save offline in 2 safe places.
ch2-p3: Receiving Pi: Share your public address (starts with G...). Sending Pi: Paste receiver address, enter amount, confirm.
ch2a-p1: Practical: Start with small test amount (1 Pi). Verify address first 4 and last 4 letters match. Never copy-paste passphrase on any website!
ch3-p1: Pi Browser is like Google Play Store for Pi. DApps are decentralized applications for real utility — shopping, education, games, services all using Pi.
ch4-p1: Discover businesses that accept Pi worldwide on mapofpi.com. Register your own business and start accepting Pi for goods and services.
ch5-p1: Global Consensus Value (GCV) encourages real utility. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. This value is built by pioneers using Pi in real trade, not by exchange price.
ch6-p1: Study Doris Yin manual for utility creation and ecosystem growth. Research, learn, and teach others — this is how we empower Africa.
final-msg: Africa has the opportunity to be one of the strongest regions in practical utility within the Pi Ecosystem. Together We Build. Together We Educate. Together We Empower Africa Through Pi.
